changes.profile_in_filing: Graduated in Mining Machinery (B.Tech) from ISM, Dhanbad in the year 1991, Shri Debabrata Ghosh has over three decades of experience in Coal India Limited, covering HEMM operation, erection and commissioning, procurement, maintenance and policy formulation. He has been instrumental in standardisation and rationalisation of HEMM, development of procurement policies, equipment life extension and initiatives towards electrification of mining equipment.

Post Graduate (M.A.) in Social Work with Specialization in Personnel Management & Industrial Relations from Madras School of Social Work, Madras University, in 1993.Shri Rajesh V Nair joined Coal India Limited in Western Coalfields Limited, a wholly Owned Subsidiary on 08.07.1994 as Welfare Officer (Trainee).In over 32 years of service, he has varied experience ranging from Unit Level Personnel Officer to Area Personnel Head, and thereafter in CIL Corporate HQ as Head of Department of Policy Cell, Rajbhasha Dept, Executive Establishment and among others.
